name: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga
storyline: The Han dynasty is dying, and the warlords stand over the body. In 190 AD, twelve houses rise against the tyrant Dong Zhuo. By 194 the realm has fragmented. In 200, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao face each other as rivals for the north. In 208, Cao Cao's fleet gathers at Red Cliffs. The player may begin in any of these years, and historical events occur only if the people involved are still alive and in place.
summary: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga is a single-player, turn-based grand strategy game set in the last years of the Han dynasty. The player chooses a warlord house and tries to unite the realm by governing cities, raising armies, forming alliances and breaking them. Sieges are fought on a tactical hex battlefield or resolved automatically, and officers remember events, hold grudges, age and die.
